headline.text: L1 Sollich 3 Russell Finex filter failed *3 times* in 24 hours — PIN broke twice, still waiting on temper at window close.

per_plant_summary.L1: Sollich 3 Russell Finex filter clogged three times, including two PIN failures requiring replacement. Line restarted after last fix but still waiting on temper at 13:28. Sollich 2 fought salt adhesion issues overnight, resolved by adjusting tunnel temp and temper. Matrix 7 missing finger — searched but not found, test finger detected by x-ray. X-ray sensitivity issue flagged at 07:29, pallets on hold.
per_plant_summary.L2: ML3 drive belt broke at noon, back up in 32 minutes. Internet outage from 00:34 to 02:30 affected label consumption. FFS printer misfired twice overnight, both cleared quickly. Film defect caused sensor trouble at 07:35, swapped roll and resumed.
per_plant_summary.L3: ML4 ran clean after resolving minor blooming and three water drain clogs. ML1 executed Hershey Heath toffee trial — rotary valve clogged at 16% inclusion, cleaned, restarted at 15%, depositing at window close. Truffle line Cavanna 1 fingers jammed at 18:57, cleared by 19:16. Internet down 01:10–02:34.

notes.text: Microsoft Outlook had nationwide outage starting around 12:43, Teams remained functional.
Sollich 2 Kitchen A butter pump issue traced to incorrect configuration from prior work; settings now locked to supervisor-level access.
Graham cracker inventory low; 15 pallets ordered for Thursday night arrival before 2nd shift.
Chocolate pallet loaded into IMS before consumption, causing inventory discrepancy; team reminded to load at point of use.

resolved.title: Sollich 3 Russell Finex PIN broken (first occurrence)
resolved.summary: Filter stopped purging at 22:50; PIN found broken at 23:52, line down, return pump pressure climbing.
resolved.resolution: Cleared 01:10 — PIN replaced by 00:34, line reheated and running.

resolved.title: Sollich 3 Separating Table 1 belt slipping from nut oil
resolved.summary: Belt slipping due to crushed nut oil between rollers; line stopped 15:13 to clean drive roller and scrapers.
resolved.resolution: Cleared 16:43 — cleaned thoroughly per maintenance request, Caleb installed flaps to reduce nut ingress, line running again.

resolved.title: Sollich 2 salt adhesion on caramel pieces
resolved.summary: Salt falling off enrobed caramel — not sticking during bagging, customer requires heavy salt coverage for Aldi run.
resolved.resolution: Cleared by 05:47 — tunnel warmed, belt slowed, temper raised +0.1; salt coverage improved and holding per spec check at 08:21.

resolved.title: Sollich 2 Kitchen A butter pump not auto-feeding
resolved.summary: Butter pump would not pull automatically; system not attempting pull when in auto mode, running Kitchen B only.
resolved.resolution: Resolved 08:15 — configuration on Side A had been changed; Marcos reset to match Side B, requested supervisor-level lockout to prevent recurrence.

resolved.title: Sollich 3 Russell Finex filter clogged (second occurrence)
resolved.summary: Filter clogged again 20 minutes after first PIN fix, unable to purge at 05:55.
resolved.resolution: Cleared 06:21 — cleaned out and reassembled, line running.

resolved.title: Sollich 4 Canada flow wrap shortage
resolved.summary: Six pallets complete out of 12-pallet Canada order, only 4 rolls FW remaining at 22:43, would last ~2 hours.
resolved.resolution: Cleared 02:41 — ran out of Canada FW, switched to BEQ USA per Luis.

resolved.title: Sollich 2 metal detector bin overfull, 20 random openings
resolved.summary: MD reject bin overflowing, saw 20 spurious openings at 02:49 check, maintenance assistance requested.
resolved.resolution: Cleared by 02:50 — Victor asked to "keep posting if you see it again," implying issue resolved or intermittent.

resolved.title: Internet / WiFi outage
resolved.summary: No internet at L2 starting 00:34; unable to consume labels, lunch breaks manual entry required.
resolved.resolution: Cleared 02:30 — Tech Legion rebooted internet, L2 and L3 both confirmed working.

resolved.title: FFS film defect causing sensor faults
resolved.summary: Film roll poorly spooled, causing faults at 07:35; worked through bad section, found second clean roll and swapped.
resolved.resolution: Cleared 08:13 — Jeffrey reports "Line is running."

resolved.title: ML3 drive belt broke
resolved.summary: Roller belt snapped at 12:05, line stopped, vacuum cleaning underway.
resolved.resolution: Cleared 12:37 — "The line is back" (Molding Line 3 Pack).

resolved.title: Panning sorter faulting out
resolved.summary: Sorting machine faulting at 18:37, cleaned glass.
resolved.resolution: Cleared same message — "cleaned the glass and it is running again."

resolved.title: FFS box printer misprinting (first time)
resolved.summary: Box printer misprinting, boxes jamming on tape machine at 22:31, line down.
resolved.resolution: Cleared 22:55 — adjusted tape machine height and printer side 2, line running.

resolved.title: FFS box printer misprinting (second time)
resolved.summary: Printer misprinting again at 23:47, maintenance working.
resolved.resolution: Cleared shortly after — line running messages resume, wifi also restored.

resolved.title: FFS film label defect (wrinkled)
resolved.summary: Label coming out with wrinkle defect at 09:21, changing film.
resolved.resolution: Cleared 09:37 — post film change "appearance meets the specifications; packaging looks great" (Claudio).

resolved.title: Smoke detector replacement
resolved.summary: New smoke detector installed, alarm reset.
resolved.resolution: Completed 09:40 — William reports "new smoke detector has been installed and alarm reset."

resolved.title: FFS knife cleaning
resolved.summary: Line down 11:18 for knife cleaning by maintenance.
resolved.resolution: Cleared 11:34 — "Line is running."

resolved.title: ML1 Heath trial rotary valve clog at 16%
resolved.summary: Hershey Heath toffee trial — depositor clogged at 16% inclusion (10:27), right rotary valve, ~1.5 hour clean required.
resolved.resolution: Cleared 12:33 — cleaned, upsized airlines, capture test at 15.1%, depositing resumed; Shawn reports "Depositing now" at 12:34.

resolved.title: Truffle Cavanna 1 fingers stuck
resolved.summary: Cavanna 1 fingers stuck at 18:57, maintenance called.
resolved.resolution: Cleared 19:16 — "Problem solved, Cavanna is running well."

resolved.title: MF Matrix X-ray over-rejecting pouches
resolved.summary: X-ray rejecting ~50 pouches, sensitivity adjusted on levels 1 & 2 from 75 to 98 at 19:16.
resolved.resolution: Cleared by 19:55 — "successfully reducing the number of rejected bags to zero at this time" (Lorena).

resolved.title: ML4 chocolate blooming visible on bars
resolved.summary: Blooming appeared on bars at 09:31, 1 piece every 2 molds; QA and supervision monitoring, making adjustments.
resolved.resolution: Cleared by 10:21 — "size of blooming decreased, now 1 bad bar every 8-10 molds," employee pulling defects; Rose confirms "all product looks good" at 10:50.

resolved.title: Sweco loose bolt on ML4 depositor 1
resolved.summary: Loose bolt observed on Sweco unit by depositor 1 at 23:40.
resolved.resolution: Cleared 00:52 — Tyson reports "I had maintenance tighten this back up."

resolved.title: Plant Standards door latch sticky
resolved.summary: L3 break room door to downstairs conference room does not latch properly.
resolved.resolution: Cleared 10:33 — William adjusted door closer, lubricated hinges and lock, "No more slow/no closing."

resolved.title: ML4 water drain clog depositor 2 (first time)
resolved.summary: Right water drain on depositor 2 clogged, line paused to unclog at 07:10.
resolved.resolution: Cleared 07:12 — "Running" (Itzel).

resolved.title: ML4 water drain clog depositor 2 (second time)
resolved.summary: Water drain clogged again at 09:09.
resolved.resolution: Cleared 09:10 — "It's ready" then "Running."

resolved.title: ML4 water drain clog depositor 2 (third time)
resolved.summary: Water drain clogged third time at 09:58.
resolved.resolution: Cleared 10:00 — "Running."

needs_attention.title: Sollich 2 Matrix 7 finger missing — potential foreign material
needs_attention.summary: Matrix 7 opener finger missing as of 06:43, last verified present at 04:30; searched line and scrap, not found; test finger detected by x-ray.
needs_attention.status: Searched thoroughly by 06:55, could not locate; separate test finger passed x-ray detection; no resolution posted by window close.

needs_attention.title: Sollich 3 X-ray not rejecting metal detector test cards
needs_attention.summary: During 07:29 x-ray check, machine failed to reject test cards; all pallets placed on hold back to last successful check.
needs_attention.status: Charity directed hold at 07:31; Troy checking as of 07:29; no "machine fixed" or "hold released" message by window close.

needs_attention.title: Sollich 3 Russell Finex PIN broken again, line waiting on temper
needs_attention.summary: Third Russell Finex failure in 24 hours — PIN broke at 10:25, found old PIN piece inside from prior repair, fan guard improperly installed.
needs_attention.status: Reassembled by 10:55, cleaned filter, reheat started 12:11; as of 13:28 "we are still waiting for temper" — 21 minutes before window close.

needs_attention.title: Sollich 2 Matrix 8 finger found in product at C15
needs_attention.summary: Production found missing M8 finger at end of conveyor C15 in product stream at 13:45.
needs_attention.status: Finger located and photographed at 13:45–13:46; appears to be the M8 finger, found downstream in product.

needs_attention.title: Eagle pallet wrapper down, not finding zero position
needs_attention.summary: Eagle pallet wrapper cannot find zero position at 12:03, maintenance disassembling to check drive chain and sensors; down to one wrapper.
needs_attention.status: Maintenance taking apart at 12:03 to inspect drive chain and sensors; no resolution posted by window close.

needs_attention.title: Sollich 2 chute/guard touching belt at enrober
needs_attention.summary: Gard or chute touching belt, needs adjustment per Kathleen at 13:31.
needs_attention.status: Reported 13:31, no acknowledgment or fix posted by 13:49 window close.

needs_attention.title: Foot sprayer popping off hinges
needs_attention.summary: Foot sprayer at entry keeps popping off after being put back on hinges; Chad reported at 07:31 and asked Dave Ruff to fix.
needs_attention.status: Chad put it back on but "using it a couple times it pops off"; requested Dave Ruff look at it; no response by window close.

needs_attention.title: MF Matrix wrapper down, missing tension roller
needs_attention.summary: Wrapper down at 20:37 due to missing roller that creates tension and regulates flow; sharing wrapper with Matrix 1 & 2.
needs_attention.status: Down as of 20:37, sharing with other matrices; no "back up" or "roller found" message by window close.
